description: R-PAR-1 PAR-ERROR, SQL-DEMAND, ERR-PARTIAL: What is written when a row in the middle of the scan raises (zm = 0 at id 100) during a write statement: INSERT INTO SINK SELECT id, 1 / zm without and with dbFailOnError, UPDATE of a copy EU SET w = 5 / w without and with dbFailOnError, and a make-table SELECT ... INTO EM; reads RecordsAffected, and the row counts and values afterwards (SINK count and Max(id); EU rows with w = 5; whether EM exists). Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-error opened read-write through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: CREATE TABLE SINK (id LONG, e LONG)
INSERT INTO SINK (id, e) SELECT id, 1 / zm FROM ER
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Max(id) AS hi FROM SINK

INSERT INTO SINK (id, e) SELECT id, 1 / zm FROM ER
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Max(id) AS hi FROM SINK
SELECT id, zm AS w INTO EU FROM ER
UPDATE EU SET w = 5 / w
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Sum(IIf(w = 5, 1, 0)) AS updated FROM EU
UPDATE EU SET w = 1

SELECT Count(*) AS n, Sum(IIf(w = 5, 1, 0)) AS updated FROM EU
SELECT id, 1 / zm AS e INTO EM FROM ER
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM EM
